title: Hardware Procurement Cancellation Terms by Order Type
content:
Hardware Procurement cancellation terms differ by order type at two stages: before the distributor purchase order is placed, and after it is placed but before shipment.

| Order type | Approved order may be cancelled free of charge before the purchase order | Order may be cancelled at all after the purchase order | Cancellation fee after the purchase order and before shipment (percent of the quote total) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Accessory & Peripheral Order | Yes | Yes | 10 |
| Standard Endpoint Order | Yes | Yes | 10 |
| Staged Endpoint Order | Yes | Yes | 15 |
| Network Equipment Order | Yes | Yes | 15 |
| Server & Storage Build Order | Yes | Yes | 25 |
| Special-Order Equipment | No | No | 100 |

## Notes

- The fee percentage is stated as a percentage of the order's quote total.
- Special-Order Equipment can be cancelled at neither stage; its fee figure of 100 percent is listed for completeness of the schedule.
- A hypothetical quote total of 2000.00 at 15 percent corresponds to 300.00; at 25 percent to 500.00.
